judgeSummaryNotes: Strongest: Screenplay B because it delivers the highest usable fidelity-to-directibility balance with consistent character locks, clip-length dialogue and complete stave coverage. Weakest: Screenplay G because it invents almost the entire narrative and dialogue, rendering it unusable as an adaptation of the source.
